bugs.summary: FishComplete now separates type, value and help with newlines, but complete() already joins completion items with newlines and fish's command substitution ($response) splits on newlines, so each field arrives as a separate $completion. The per-item split then finds one field, $metadata[2]/[3] are missing, and fish completion breaks for every command.
bugs.trigger:
Any fish completion: the output 'plain
foo
_
plain
bar
_' is iterated as six entries ('plain', 'foo', '_', ...), so no candidate is offered (regression reported as #3502; fixed in b7e5fd4).

related_valid: A completion value or help containing a tab still breaks the value\tdescription format fish expects.
